name: openmarketing-hero-video
description: The 16:9 hero video for openmarketing.dev, built with Remotion. Renders to website/public/hero.mp4.

scripts.sound: python3 scripts/sfx.py out/hero-sound.wav && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/hero-master.mp4 -i out/hero-sound.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.5:LRA=9 -ar 48000 -c:a aac -b:a 192k -shortest -movflags +faststart out/hero-sound.mp4
scripts.web: ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/hero-master.mp4 -an -c:v libx264 -crf 23 -preset slow -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart ${WEB_OUT:-../../website/public}/hero.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/hero-master.mp4 -an -c:v libvpx-vp9 -crf 38 -b:v 0 -row-mt 1 ${WEB_OUT:-../../website/public}/hero.webm && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -ss 7.2 -i out/hero-master.mp4 -frames:v 1 -q:v 3 ${WEB_OUT:-../../website/public}/hero-poster.jpg
